text:
maria: Heads up — we're kicking off the v2 staged shift during the 02:00-04:00 PST change window. Plan is small-step: 5% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100% over ~3 hours. Operator eyes required at each stage. Pinned clients should remain on v1; we will only move unpinned traffic. @amir please own the first hour. :rocket:

deploy-bot: Scheduled rollout created by maria. Stages: canary@5% (5990011523), ramp@25% (5990012123), ramp@50% (5990012723), cutover@100% (5990013323). Command for ops: `deploybot run --release v2 --stages 5,25,50,100 --wait 900`

kyle: quick q — how are we treating header-pinned clients? if a tenant sends `x-redwood-version: v1` will we still route them to v1?
maria: Yes — header pins and tenant pins remain honored. We won't force any client to v2. Only unpinned requests get the staged routing. If a client explicitly prefers v2 we'll respect it, but we won't rewrite pins.

jen: I can push a short release-notes blurb and customer notice. Anything specific to call out for mobile SDKs?
maria: Callouts: 1) no forced client changes, 2) improved token-level latency (expect ~10-15% lower p50 on common models), 3) optional header `x-redwood-version: prefer-v2` for early adopters. Also note: quantized variants enabled for some workloads — may slightly change decoding characteristics; include rollback instructions.

amir: I'm on for 02:00-03:00. I'll monitor p95 latency, 5xx spike, and tik-tok eval regressions. Alerts I care about: `>=3% 5xx sustained >5m`, `P95 > baseline *1.4`, and eval-set BLEU/ROUGE drop >2pts.
kyle: What are exact rollback steps if we hit an alert?
maria: Short runbook: 1) Pause next stage: `deploybot pause --release v2` 2) If incident meets rollback criteria, run `deploybot rollback --to v1 --reason "<reason>"` 3) Notify infra and product channels, open incident bridge if >15m. Full runbook: https://go/redwood/runbooks/v2-rollout (ops-only). :rotating_light:

jen: I'll add tenant opt-out checklist and the customer-facing blurb. Can someone paste the pinned-tenant list?
maria: Pinned tenants (do not migrate): `billing-prod`, `analytics-enterprise`, `gov-eu-az`, `legacy-sdk-test`. I'll DM secure list for ops.

amir: ACK. I'll have dashboards up: gateway p95, model decode latency, 5xx by tenant, and sample generation quality spikes. If I see gateway upstream `502` spikes or token-latency > threshold I'll trigger pause.
kyle: thumbs up. one last ask — can we add a temporary surge throttle for new v2 sessions (to protect small clusters)?
maria: Good call. Enabling temporary tenant surge-protection: `routing-config set --v2-throttle 50rps-per-tenant --window 60s` for first 45m. Ops, please confirm after enabling.
amir: enabled and verified on staging. I'll flip to prod 5m before the first stage.

deploy-bot: Note: watch windows created: 5990011523-5990012123 (canary), 5990012123-5990012723 (ramp), 5990012723-5990013323 (cutover). Alerts wired to #eng-oncall and #product-safety.
kyle: thanks all — I'll be online for the first two stages.
maria: Thanks team. If no blocks we'll start at scheduled time. I'll post a one-line status at each stage. :white_check_mark:
